thread:
marta: Quick heads-up — I'm planning to lift the runtime pin for 2.14 on the canary cohort tomorrow 03:00 UTC unless we see blocking signals. Noting some stickiness in eu-west routes overnight. :eyes:
deploybot: [automated] Pinlist status at 2026-11-02T22:40Z: runtime-2.14 -> PINNED (canary: true, regions: eu-west/us-east). Recent mismatch alerts: 3 routes showing SDK v1.4.2 vs runtime v2.14 agent.
sam: Can you share which routes? I want to run the compat test matrix before we touch anything.
marta: Mostly customer-facing embed endpoints: /v1/embeddings and some small sandbox traffic. I pulled logs, see a pattern where the SDK handshake drops on long-seq quant models.
irene: Confirming — saw an intermittent kv cache refetch in eu-west on the long-seq job at 22:12. Stack trace snippet: `runtime: kvcache miss -> fallback kernel v1; sdk: handshake timeout 120ms`
ben: Given that, my vote is to *soft-unpin* (allow rollout but keep sticky routing for routes that flapped). We should set a 2-hour grace window with automatic fallback to model-variant `2.14-compat` if latency/regression > 10%.
marta: I like soft-unpin, but deploybot shows ~6% of traffic still on SDK 1.4.2 which lacks the shim for the new kvcache header. If we proceed, we'll cause those routes to error.
sam: We can push an SDK patch fast but rolling it globally before the unpin is risky. Alternative: add a routing rule: if header `X-Runtime-KV=v2` missing -> route to older runtime 2.13 for 24h. Low-change, low-risk.
irene: That routing rule is doable from ops side; I can gate by route tags. Quick sample rule: ```if not header("X-Runtime-KV") then route: runtime=2.13 fallback=true```
deploybot: [proposed action] schedule soft-unpin 03:00 UTC with routing guard for `missing-kv-header` -> route to 2.13. Auto-fallback metric: p50 latency >=150ms or error-rate delta >0.05 triggers rollback.
ben: Two nitpicks: 1) ensure metric window is 5m rolling, 2) exclude nightly-batch jobs from the guard (they'll warm anyway).
marta: Agreed. Also we should broadcast in #support and add a short release note: "Soft-unpin runtime 2.14 on canary; routing guard in place for routes missing kv header; SDK owners please patch to 1.4.3 ASAP."
oncall-bot: [reminder] oncall: sam (primary), irene (secondary) for the 03:00 UTC window.
sam: I'll be on. I'll also stage a quick canary test: `curl -H 'X-Runtime-KV: v2' https://canary.example/v1/embeddings | jq '.latency'` — will report before 02:45 UTC.
marta: Decision: Soft-unpin at 03:00 UTC with routing guard and 5m rolling metrics. SDK owners notified to push 1.4.3; if any route crosses thresholds we rollback to 2.13 for that route only. I'll post the release note and open a follow-up thread for post-rollout regressions. :white_check_mark:
